metadata.title: MedOrbits College Directory -- Private-Priority India and International
metadata.description: Expanded candidate directory covering private Indian colleges and higher-education institutions, national public institutions, and international universities/colleges across medicine, engineering, management, pharmacy, nursing, law, architecture, design, arts and sciences, agriculture, veterinary and allied health. Private Indian institutions are prioritized; records are not verified unless authoritative evidence is recorded.
